canada.title: Kinew kicking off NDP convention in ‘critical election year’
canada.summary: New Democrats from across Manitoba are gathering in Winnipeg to debate policy resolutions and get ready for a provincial election that is due on or before Oct. 5.

canada.title: YMCA Winnipeg opens swimming lessons to public because of pool closures in city
canada.summary: For the first time in its 147-year history, the YMCA-YWCA of Winnipeg is allowing non-members to join its swimming lessons — an action prompted by the wave of public pool closures in the city.

canada.summary: A new report on food access in Nunavut says the territory continues to be in a “food security crisis” and children are most affected.

canada.title: More electric vehicles exempt from luxury tax, Ottawa says
canada.summary: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne announced that starting Friday, all electric vehicles that cost less than $150,000 would be exempt from the 10 per cent tax.

canada.title: Lethbridge company fined $350K following 2024 worker death at McCain Foods plant
canada.summary: Zero Gravity Crane & Rigging Inc. pleaded guilty in Lethbridge court to one count under the Occupational Health and Safety Code for failing to ensure a worker was protected from falling through a hole in a work surface.

canada.title: Province pulls licence for Living Sky Wildlife Rehab after Saskatoon non-profit fined in court
canada.summary: Living Sky Wildlife Rehabilitation's founder pleaded guilty to 'technical violations' but did not harm animals, court heard before issuing over $2,000 in fines.

canada.title: Aviation expert calls PAL Airlines wheel loss incidents unusual and 'disturbing'
canada.summary: McGill University aviation management expert John Gradek says PAL Airlines needs to seriously evaluate its maintenance practices after one of its aircraft lost a wheel — for the second time in two weeks.

canada.title: How Microsoft's global outage is affecting some Montreal services

canada.summary: An open letter to Prime Minister Mark Carney and Indigenous Services Minister Mandy Gull Masty calls for an end to second-generation cut-off.

canada.title: Alberta landowners should be allowed to kill problem grizzly bears, says rural municipalities group
canada.summary: The Rural Municipalities of Alberta will lobby the province on grizzly bear management changes for the third time since 2024. Yellowhead County and other municipalities are calling for landowners to be allowed to kill grizzlies that pose a threat to their livestock or property.

canada.title: Saskatchewan hospital safety review complete, but findings won’t be released yet
canada.summary: The six-month review is now in the health ministry's hands, but Health Minister Jeremy Cockrill says he does not want to expose vulnerabilities until they are addressed.
